title: Locating a hold's central grief-room required long undirected wandering through large branching outdoor mazes with only a single vague compass phrase to go on — Thornwold's 'west past the Waiting Bough' took roughly 25 blind room-to-room steps through the forest maze around Camp Gallows before I found it.
